summary_en: This study tests AVM0703 in people with lymphoid malignancies, which are cancers that start in lymphoid cells. The record lists several lymphomas and leukemias, including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. AVM0703 is given as a single intravenous infusion over about 1 hour. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body (pharmacokinetics), and early signs of antitumor activity. It is a Phase 1/2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa AVM0703 en personas con neoplasias linfoides, que son cánceres que se originan en las células linfoides. El registro incluye varios linfomas y leucemias, entre ellos el linfoma difuso de células B grandes y la leucemia linfocítica crónica. AVM0703 se administra como una sola infusión intravenosa de aproximadamente 1 hora. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo se mueve el medicamento por el cuerpo (farmacocinética) y las primeras señales de actividad antitumoral. Es un estudio de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Age 12 years or older and weight at least 40 kg.
Lymphoid cancer of a listed type that has returned or did not respond to prior treatment.
Lansky or Karnofsky performance status of 50 or higher.
Blood counts, liver tests, kidney function and lung reserve within the limits set in the record.
Able to give written informed consent; minors need parent or guardian consent and their own assent.
not_for: History of another cancer, except the listed exceptions.
Significant heart disease, heart rhythm problems, or uncontrolled high blood pressure as defined in the record.
Known stomach or duodenal ulcer, or uncontrolled diabetes.
Untreated active infection, including hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV, or tuberculosis under the listed conditions.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or taking part in another therapeutic clinical study (except AVM0703-001).
